acceptanceCriteria: A change that only adds a sealed .corvint/changes/*.cem.json selects no reader units beyond those the spec names
body: Each sealed CEM under .corvint/changes/ makes the readers of that directory (8 units on the PR #1134 range) PATH_LITERAL_READERs, so every lane's affected plan pays for them. Expected: a narrowing analogous to the AFP-V0-021 sidecar rule for sealed CEM additions. Evidence: lane gh-affbroad1806 analysis (V1-1806 residual).
title: affected: every dogfood seal selects the 8 .corvint/changes/ reader units
